experiment: BoN: how far does each judge carry you from random

design.pi_init: gpt-4o-mini attacker via src.qd_mutation.genesis (same as the QD run)
design.proxy: judge level on trial 0 only (what a search observes)
design.gold: mean over trials 1 and 2 of oracle attributed_severity / 4 (held out from selection: winner's-curse control)
design.judge_failures: level None after the built-in retry counts as 0; the count per judge is reported; any judge above 1% is flagged and H-B is reported with and without it

selectors.floor: uniform random (gold mean over all N)
selectors.ceiling: oracle attributed_severity on trial 0, gold on trials 1-2

estimator: src/bon.py -- exact tie-aware best-of-n selection probabilities; no Monte Carlo

primary_endpoint.note: both n fixed before data; not chosen after seeing curves

H-A.rule: at n=32, at least one pair of judges has non-overlapping 95% bootstrap intervals (2000 resamples of the N samples; floor, ceiling and judge value recomputed per resample)

H-B.claim: selection efficiency is predicted by static calibration
H-B.predictor: over-credit rate at n=1: share of samples the judge scores > 0 minus share the oracle scores > 0 on trial 0
H-B.rule: Spearman rho between predictor and n=32 efficiency, one-sided (more over-credit -> lower efficiency), exact permutation p < 0.05

H-C.rule: report every judge's (over-credit rate, efficiency); no significance test

H-D.claim: the least efficient judge loses efficiency as n grows (Goodhart signature)
H-D.rule: slope of efficiency on log2 n over n in {4, 8, 16, 32}, bootstrap interval

saturation.claim: a four-level score caps selection pressure at log(1 / top-level share)
saturation.rule: report effective KL vs closed form per judge; compare to log(N / #top-scored)

robustness.proxy_without_L3: re-rank with each judge's L3 mapped to 0 (its internal-delivery credit set aside). The oracle never awards L3, so this is a proxy-side check -- a gold-side strict/full split would be vacuous

judge_self_noise.report: per-judge agreement of the 3 calls on the same trajectory

power.mini_vs_rest: illustrative efficiencies 0.40 vs >=0.90 (existing data, not i.i.d.); expected to be detected at N=512
power.gpt4o_vs_sonnet: illustrative 0.90 vs 0.98; likely NOT separable at N=512. Failing to separate them is not evidence they are equal
power.H-B_risk: if the added judges cluster near the ceiling their order is noise and H-B can fail for that reason alone; that is not evidence against H-B
